summary:
Fortinet上季營收與每股盈餘雙雙優於市場預期，展現強勁的網路安全業務成長動能。
• 每股盈餘達0.90美元，超出市場預期的0.75美元。
• 季度營收達20.5億美元，較去年同期成長25.64%。
• 核心網路安全產品與服務需求持續擴大，推動獲利能力提升。
ai_view:
觀點：財報表現穩健展現基本面強韌，短線上有助於支撐高評價水準，中長期則需觀察企業資安預算與訂閱服務續約率。追蹤指標包含續約成長率、營業利益率與總體經濟對IT支出的影響。

需留意：高達55倍的本態比反映市場已計入高度成長期望，若成長放緩面臨估值修正風險。；資安產業競爭激烈，大型雲端巨頭與新創公司持續分食市場占有率。

summary_en:
Fortinet reported better-than-expected quarterly revenue and earnings, driven by robust cybersecurity momentum.
• Earnings per share came in at $0.90, beating the estimated $0.75.
• Quarterly revenue reached $2.05B, representing a 25.64% year-over-year increase.
• Strong demand for core cybersecurity products and services drove improved profitability.

ai_view_en:
view: Solid earnings demonstrate operational resilience, supporting the premium valuation in the near term. Mid- to long-term performance will depend on enterprise security budgets and subscription renewal rates. Key metrics to track include billings growth, operating margins, and macroeconomic impacts on IT spending.

Watch：A trailing P/E of 55.02 indicates high growth expectations, posing valuation compression risks if growth slows.; Intense competition in the cybersecurity sector from cloud giants and startups threatens market share.
beat_or_miss: 超預期，EPS 0.90美元優於預估的0.75美元，且營收年增逾25%。
